sources.citation: Verheijen, Jilis A. J. 1984. Plant names in Austronesian linguistics. NUSA: Linguistic Studies of Indonesian and Other Languages in Indonesia, vol. 20. Jakarta: Badan Penyelenggara Seri NUSA, Universitas Katolik Indonesia Atma Jaya. viii+98 pp.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Sec. 1.3.3 'Orthography and pronunciation' (p.2) is the only phonological content: orthography based on Indonesian, /q/ glottal stop, /e/ murmured e, /é/, glottalised b d etc. written bh dh outside Manggarai proper, gh for the voiced laryngeal fricative, and for Sumba a long vs a short stressed /a/; explicitly disclaims precision for languages outside Manggarai. No statement on word stress for any Flores lect; the only other 'stressed' remark concerns Makassarese bakaraq. scanned of pp.1-24, 81-82, 101-104.
